sport.title: How Roger Federer’s results were after he returned from serious knee injury in 2017 as Jannik Sinner struggles
paras: Sinner – who recently hired Magnus Norman as his coach for 2027 – suffered a knee injury in the lead-up to the US Open. Progress has been slow for the 24-year-old, and he chose to end his season at the start of October .

Sinner is far from the only tennis superstar to have suffered a long-term injury. Carlos Alcaraz – Sinner’s main rival on the Tour – dealt with a long-term wrist injury for the best part of four months earlier this year. Roger Federer, a 20-time Grand Slam champion, also suffered significant knee injuries during the middle portion of his career.

sport.title: How Daniil Medvedev’s ranking has changed since the end of 2025 as he concludes 2026 campaign
paras: Medvedev has bounced back emphatically from a poor 2025 season, winning multiple titles and producing some of his best tennis when the stakes have been highest. The Russian’s good season was encapsulated in Turin over the past week; Medvedev advanced to the semi-finals, beating Flavio Cobolli and Frances Tiafoe – before losing to a rampant Alexander Zverev .

Following the conclusion of Medvedev’s season, it is worth assessing just how much Medvedev has progressed over the past year. Medvedev’s 2025 season was littered with poor results and disappointing performances. Will Daniil Medvedev ever win another Grand Slam title?

sport.title: November 23, 1997: The day Novotna beat Pierce to triumph at WTA Finals and overcome a major hurdle
paras: On this day in tennis history, Jana Novotna won the women’s year-end championships to pave the way for her Grand Slam breakthrough months later On this day, November 23, 1997, Jana Novotna defeated Mary Pierce in the final of the WTA year-end championships (7-6, 6-2, 6-3) to claim the first major title of her career.

The Czech had been one of the best players in the world over the past five years, but on several big occasions stumbled in the moment of truth. The confidence she accumulated thanks to this success probably helped her to win her first and only Grand Slam singles title six months later at Wimbledon .

sport.title: Boris Becker names three ATP youngsters who could be threats next year, ‘I’m a big fan’
paras: Boris Becker is already looking ahead to who could be competing at the ATP Finals next year. The ATP Finals have featured some familiar faces, with Carlos Alcaraz , Alexander Zverev , Daniil Medvedev and Ben Shelton all competing in Turin, but they have also seen some new names qualify for the year-end tournament.

This year has featured four debutants in the ATP Finals, with Flavio Cobolli , Arthur Fils , Frances Tiafoe and Rafael Jodar all qualifying to compete in Turin. These four debutants all struggled at the ATP Finals , and three-time former champion Becker has predicted three more players who could make their debut at the year-end tournament in 2027.

paras: Carlos Alcaraz has beaten current world number one Alexander Zverev in both of their matches this year. Alcaraz beat Zverev 6-2, 7-6(7) to win the ATP Finals title for the first time in his career and extend his winning streak to 14 matches.
